title: Plux experiment document
description: An experiment: a control and variants with their allocation, audience, schedule and metrics (ABT-001). Its `key` is the PXL name in `experiment.<key>` and the `experiment` of a `Variant` node. File: `experiments/<key>.experiment.json`.

props.description: The props a `prop` experiment varies, read in PXL as `experiment.<key>.<name>`; every variant gives each a value.

variants.description: The control and the variants. Exactly one is the control and the weights sum to 100 (PLX-1702, PLX-1703).

holdout.description: The share of subjects, in percent, kept out of the experiment and shown the control.

segment.description: A segment the experiment targets. With `segments` it is the first of them.

segments.description: More segments to target. A device in any of them, this document's `segment` included, is eligible (limit `experiments.segmentsPerTargeting`).

attributes.description: Conditions on device and user attributes. A device must meet every one of them, as well as be in one of the segments if any are named (limit `experiments.attributesPerTargeting`).

primaryMetric.description: The lead primary metric; its sample sets the minimum sample size check.

primaryMetrics.description: More primary metrics, analysed like the lead one (limit `experiments.primaryMetrics`, the lead metric included).

minimumSampleSize.description: Subjects per variant before a result may be read.

salt.description: Mixed into the hash that assigns a subject to a variant, so two experiments split the same subjects differently (ABT-002).

experimentScope.description: What varies: a whole page, a component subtree (a `Variant` node), a prop value, a flow, or the version of a plugin.

metricKind.description: How a metric is analysed: the share of subjects that did the event, or the mean of a numeric property of the event.

metricDirection.description: Which change of the metric is an improvement.

weight.description: The share of subjects, in percent.

props.description: The value of each declared prop for this variant.

experimentSchedule.description: When the experiment runs; both bounds are optional.

event.description: The analytics event the metric counts.

maxRegression.description: For a guardrail: the largest relative worsening tolerated, as a fraction.
